outcome_name: Ovulation with metformin added to clomifene
outcome_population: as randomised; background ovulation-induction therapy disclosed per trial
source: Ben Ayed 2009, abstract: '32 PCOS women were recruited in the study and equally allocated to the two groups. The ovulation rate in the metformin group was 62.5% compared with 37.5% in the placebo group.' Equal allocation of 32 -> 16 per arm; counts are exact: 62.5% of 16 = 10, 37.5% of 16 = 6 (an S2 add-on-to-clomifene contrast, metformin+CC vs CC+placebo).
analysis_set: as randomised; background ovulation-induction therapy disclosed per trial
